meta.name: autoskill
meta.description: Observe the user's screen via screenpipe, detect repeated research workflows, match them against existing scientific-agent-skills, and draft new skills (or composition recipes that chain existing ones) for the patterns not yet covered. Use when the user asks to analyze their recent work and propose skills based on what they actually do. Requires the screenpipe daemon (https://github.com/screenpipe/screenpipe) running locally on port 3030 — the skill has no other data source and will refuse to run if screenpipe is unreachable. All detection runs locally; only redacted cluster summaries reach the LLM.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 观察你的屏幕操作,自动找出重复流程并生成新技能建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望助手能根据你日常操作自动沉淀成可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Watch your screen, find repeated workflows, auto-suggest new skills
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to turn your daily habits into reusable skills

howto.what: 这个技能会读取本机的 screenpipe 屏幕使用记录,分析你在一段时间里的重复科研操作,与仓库里已有的技能比对;对没覆盖到的操作,它起草新技能或能把已有技能串联起来的配方,连同报告存进草稿文件夹,由你审阅后再决定是否收纳。
howto.when: 当你明确提出分析近期工作并提出技能建议的要求时才触发,如“分析我最近一天/一周并提出技能建议”;它要求本机 screenpipe 守护进程已运行,否则拒绝执行,也不回应实时查屏等随口请求。

say.text: 分析我最近 4 小时的工作,提议新技能。
say.note: 它会抓取这 4 小时的屏幕记录,聚类后产出待审阅提案。

say.text: 看看我这些天的重复操作里,哪些还没有对应技能。
say.note: 它会把重复模式与仓库现有技能比对,指出缺口。

say.text: 把我常用的文献检索流程,起草成串联已有技能的配方。
say.note: 确认能由现有技能覆盖时,它会产生一份组合配方草稿。

howto.what_en: Pulls recent screen activity from local screenpipe, groups repeated research workflows, and compares them to existing skills in this repo. Uncovered workflows get drafted as new skills or as recipes chaining existing skills, saved to a proposal folder for review.
howto.when_en: Triggered by an explicit request to analyze recent work and propose skills (e.g. 'analyze my last week and propose skills'). Requires the local screenpipe daemon on port 3030.

say_en.text: Analyze my last 4 hours of work and propose new skills.
say_en.note: It clusters that window and drafts proposals for review.

say_en.text: Look at what I've done this week and tell me what isn't covered yet.
say_en.note: It compares patterns to existing skills and lists gaps.

say_en.text: Draft a composition recipe chaining existing skills for literature workflows.
say_en.note: Writes a recipe draft chaining skills for that workflow.
